flag_block_system.half_turn_action: fixed-point-free on the six sheets; swaps the two apartment lifts above each point-line flag

theorem: The 1620-to-270 apartment map is the homogeneous six-sheet cover G/K -> G/H with |K|=16, |H|=96. Its local monodromy is exactly D12. The natural 3x2 flag block system quotients D12 to S3, and the kernel is the central half-turn that exchanges the two lifts of every selected point-line flag.
verification: Independently recomputed in this run from the PSp action on the six apartment lifts over one selected singular line.
boundary: This is finite cover monodromy. It supplies a precise selector obstruction/duo-bit structure but is not by itself an optical or dynamical holonomy.
